evaluator: Blind Stagebench Phase 2 evaluator; measured the published build in headless Chromium with a recording tap patched onto AudioNode.prototype.connect at the destination, A/B-ing every unit, type and control on rendered signal.
summary: A strong, unusually honest Phase 2. Six piano types are measurably distinct (C4 band distance 9.95-24.4 dB, centroids 385-1406 Hz); Grand/Upright/Electric are 71 real bundled WAVs that all decode, 24 kHz mono 16-bit, byte counts matching the declaration, with complete redistributable provenance. Exactly one AudioContext and one destination connection; per-layer chains, ordered units (delay->amp and reverb->rotary both verified), click-free bypass restoring dry to within 0.02 dB, and a limiter holding 0.894 with zero clipped samples under 40 max-velocity notes. Dyn Comp, KB Touch, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release and String Res all change rendered signal as the manual describes. Two defects pull it down: Hall and Cathedral reverbs self-oscillate to full scale from one 200 ms note and never decay, and the spec-required FX group and global modes are absent and undeclared.

criteria.label: Instrument breadth & character
evidence: All six types are audibly distinct on C4 in the served build: spectral centroid 962 Hz (Grand), 519 (Upright), 538 (Electric), 1406 (Clav), 393 (Digital), 386 (Misc); minimum pairwise distance over 24 log bands is 9.95 dB (Grand/Clav), maximum 24.4 dB (Grand/Misc).

Character matches the assigned namesakes rather than one relabelled voice: Grand's partials are 1.00/0.996/0.412 at 260.7/524.4/788.1 Hz, Upright is 2nd-harmonic dominant with weak upper partials (0.142 at 785 Hz), Electric shows tine-like strong 3rd and 5th (0.412 at 785 Hz, 0.116 at 1310 Hz), and Misc is a mallet with a dominant 4th harmonic (0.132 at 1040 Hz) and no 2nd.
Decay differs per type as expected, measured from the rendered envelope: Clav reaches -40 dB in 0.71 s versus 1.13 s (Grand), 1.42 s (Electric) and 1.55 s (Digital).

Weakness: velocity changes level far more than timbre. Between velocity 0.2 and 0.675 the spectral-band distance is only 0.17 dB on Upright and 0.19 dB on Electric (1.8 dB Grand, 3.2 dB Clav), while the RMS ratio is a near-identical 0.271-0.279 on all six types, so the two declared velocity layers barely read as separate strokes.

criteria.label: Effect audibility & correctness
evidence: Critical: Hall and Cathedral reverbs self-oscillate. After a single 200 ms C4 at dry/wet 6.4, measured output RMS grows 0.047 (1 s) -> 0.362 (4 s) -> 0.890 (9 s) -> 0.894 (14 s) for Hall and 0.149 -> 0.818 -> 0.894 -> 0.894 for Cathedral, never decaying; at dry/wet 10 the roar sits at the 0.8936 limiter ceiling before any note is played. Booth/Room/Spring/Stage decay correctly to 0.000.

Every other unit and type processes real audio and behaves like its namesake. Mod 1: A-Pan alone produces stereo (side/mid 0.380 vs 0.000 dry) with no level modulation; Trem modulates amplitude only (depth 0.999 at amount 10, 0.383 at amount 5, bit-identical to dry at amount 0, matching 'full level at zero amount'); Ring Mod shifts the spectrum 18.95 dB; A-Wah is envelope-driven (centroid 962 -> 730 Hz); Wah sweeps at depth 1.0; Pump ducks (depth 0.396).

Delay filters the repeats and not the dry path, exactly as specified: with LP/BP/HP the late-window (0.9-3.0 s) centroid is 941/1120/1245 Hz while the dry peak stays at 0.1193 in all three. Tap tempo agrees with the knob: five taps at 600 ms moved the readout 8.0 -> 5.2 and produced measured repeat gaps of 0.597-0.619 s.

Bypass is exact and click-free: fx.section-on Off with all six units engaged returns the signal to within 0.02 dB of dry, and the largest sample-to-sample jump when toggling any unit mid-note (0.0406) falls during the note attack at 0.16-0.27 s, never at the 0.8 s toggle instant.

Compressor matches manual p.52: amount 10 narrows the loud/soft range from 17.59 dB to 12.08 dB by lifting soft strokes (RMS 0.0086 -> 0.0223) while barely moving loud ones, and amount 0 is identical to bypassed.
Mod 2's three widening types sit close together: Chorus/Spin 3.02 dB, Ensemble/Spin 3.68 dB, Chorus/Ensemble 4.09 dB apart, separated mainly by stereo width (0.345/0.527/0.235).

criteria.label: Signal graph & gain staging
evidence: Exactly one AudioContext and one destination connection, counted by patching AudioNode.prototype.connect and the AudioContext constructor before page load: ctxCount 1, offlineCount 0, destination connects 1, sample rate 48000, state 'running'.

Per-layer buses are real: with FX focus on Piano B, Mod 1 On applies to B only and reads back Off when focus returns to Piano A; layer levels are independent (A only 0.0319, A+B 0.0852, B level 0 -> 0.0505, B level 10 -> 0.1135 RMS).

Master limiter holds under load: 24 and 40 simultaneous notes at velocity 1.0 with Master Level 10 both peak at exactly 0.89363 with 0 clipped samples; Master Level is monotonic (0 -> silence, 3 -> 0.0123, 7.5 -> 0.0328, 10 -> 0.0410) and piano.section-on Off yields RMS exactly 0.

Documented order confirmed at two landmarks: engaging To Rotary makes the reverb tail itself rotary-processed (tail side/mid 0.000 -> 0.528), so reverb precedes rotary; raising Amp drive to 10 lifts the delay repeats from tail RMS 0.0145 to 0.1063, so delay precedes Amp/EQ.

Gain staging inside the reverb feedback path is unstable rather than merely loud: the Hall/Cathedral tank drives the master limiter into permanent 0.894 saturation, so the limiter ends up doing the work a stable tank should have done.

criteria.label: Two-layer piano behaviour
evidence: Both layers enable, level and play independently: measured RMS 0.0319 (A only), 0.0852 (A+B), 0.0505 (B level 0), 0.1135 (B level 10), 0.0378 (A level 0), with the panel faders and LED ladders tracking.

Per-layer instrument and octave reach the audio graph: with A=Grand and B=Clav the Program display reads 'PIANO B - CLAV / CLAV (SYNTHESISED)' and the combined centroid moves 933 -> 1158 Hz; one press of piano.octave-up then shows 'PIANO B - CLAV - OCT +1' and moves the centroid to 1469 Hz while layer A's 260.7 Hz fundamental is untouched.

Effect focus follows layer focus with independent chains, verified by reading fx.mod1.on back as 'On' under Piano B focus and 'Off' under Piano A focus in the same session; src/audio/settings.ts:80-96 gives each LayerSettings its own ChainSettings.
Sustain routes per section: with the pedal held, late-window (0.6-2.2 s) RMS is 0.01784 with SUSTPED On versus 0.000013 with SUSTPED Off and 0 with no pedal.

criteria.label: Detailed piano controls
evidence: Dyn Comp reproduces the manual's description exactly: Off/1/2/3 narrow the velocity-0.2-to-1.0 range from 17.60 to 9.57 to 5.94 to 3.26 dB by lifting soft strokes (RMS 0.0089 -> 0.0224 -> 0.0340 -> 0.0464) while the loud stroke stays at 0.067489 and its centroid stays at 1220.3 Hz, i.e. no timbre change.
KB Touch spans a 15.7 dB response range at one fixed physical velocity (Heavy 0.00442, Medium 0.00890, Normal 0.01485, Light 0.02681) with centroid essentially unchanged at 919-923 Hz.

Timbre, Unison, Soft Release and String Res all move rendered signal: Timbre Off/Soft/Mid/Bright gives centroid 962/715/1029/1267 Hz; Unison Off/1/2/3 gives stereo side/mid 0.000/0.319/0.379/0.393; Soft Release lengthens the -40 dB decay from 0.325 s to 0.432 s and raises release-window RMS from 0.000002 to 0.000187; String Res is correctly inaudible on one note (0.36 dB) but adds 2.2 dB of level and 3.94 dB of spectral change on a three-note chord.

Weakness: the Dyno tine emulations are near-inaudible. On Electric, Dyno 1 differs from Timbre Off by only 0.43 dB across the 24 bands (centroid 534.4 vs 537.7 Hz) and Dyno 1 from Dyno 2 by 0.83 dB; Bright moves the Electric centroid only 537 -> 565 Hz against 962 -> 1267 Hz on Grand.

criteria.label: Input reliability & failure behaviour
evidence: Zero console errors and zero page errors across every battery run against the build (six type switches, roughly 40 effect A/Bs, sustain tests, and 61 simultaneous held notes); voice cleanup is confirmed by the held-note readout returning to 00 after release.

Failure degrades visibly, not silently: with all requests to /samples/** aborted, the status strip reads 'FALLBACK VOICE', the keybed stays playable on the synthesised voice (RMS 0.0690, centroid 348 Hz), and the recorded library is never reported ready; absent Web MIDI reports 'MIDI DENIED' and a suspended context reports 'AUDIO SUSPENDED'.

Stress is handled cleanly: 40 simultaneous notes at velocity 1.0 with Master Level 10 produce peak 0.89363 and 0 clipped samples, and repeated identical shots are bit-identical (RMS 0.030735 reproduced exactly across runs), showing deterministic voice handling.

Sustain is correctly ignored while a panel control holds focus (documented at src/input/keymap.ts:51-59) and works once focus is cleared, so the keyboard mapping does not fight the accessible controls.

Two blemishes: the Program display's 'VOICES' field shows held-key count rather than sounding voices (src/App.tsx:57 assigns instrument.heldNotes.size), reading 45 and 61 while src/audio/pianoEngine.ts:89 caps voices at 32; and the Hall/Cathedral runaway is an unrecoverable loud state that persists at 0.894 until the reverb type is changed or the page reloaded.

criteria.label: Required piano instruments
evidence: All six required types are selectable and load, each naming its model in the Program display: Concert Grand YDP, Upright KW, Tine EP, and Clav/Digital/Mallet each suffixed '(SYNTHESISED)' with the strip reading 'SYNTHESISED' instead of 'RECORDED SAMPLES'.
Every bundled sample decodes: all 71 WAVs under build/samples were fetched and decoded in the page with 0 failures and 0 silent files (peak range 0.486-0.890, duration 0.708-3.40 s).

Provenance is verifiable rather than asserted: WAV headers confirm 1 channel / 24000 Hz / 16-bit as declared, and per-set byte totals match IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json exactly (grand 4058332, upright 3802250, electric 1402428); artifact/tools/build-samples.py names the upstream releases and licences (FreePats YDP CC BY 3.0, UprightPianoKW CC0, FluidR3 MIT).

Sample density avoids audible uniform stretching: grand roots run every 6 semitones from MIDI 27 to 105 in v80/v127 pairs (28 files), so no note is stretched more than 3 semitones; the sets are same-origin static assets and work offline.

criteria.label: Required effect units and types
evidence: All six units plus the shared Rotary are present and reachable, and every listed type is selectable from the panel: Mod 1 A-Pan/Trem/RM/A-Wah/Wah/Pump, Mod 2 Chorus/Flanger/Phaser/Vibe/Ensemble/Spin, Reverb Room/Booth/Spring/Stage/Hall/Cathedral, plus Reverb tone Normal/Bright/Dark and Rotary Slow/Fast/Morph, enumerated by cycling each button in the running build.

Group mode is absent: no group control exists anywhere in the 147-control DOM inventory and no group field exists in the settings model (src/audio/settings.ts:71-106 defines ChainSettings/LayerSettings/EngineSettings with no grouping), although the effects spec lists group mode as required.

Global mode is absent: with fx.shift set to On, clicking fx.comp.on left the Compressor reading 'Off' with no display change, so the spec's Shift+On global targeting for Delay/Compressor/Reverb does nothing.

The Amp Sim/EQ unit offers six type positions (Twin, JC, Small, To Rotary, LP Filter, HP Filter) with no 'EQ only' position, against the seven the effects spec lists; the Delay feedback filter offers LP/BP/HP with no 'Off' position, against the spec's Off/LP/HP/BP.

What is present works well: Amp types are distinct (Twin/JC 7.48 dB, JC/Small 8.46 dB, Twin/Small 4.12 dB apart; drive 0 -> 10 moves centroid 1106 -> 2763 Hz), LP24 sweeps centroid 256 -> 1042 Hz with resonance adding 3.35 dB, and Rotary responds to speed (Slow/Fast 2.0 vs 9.94 dB from dry) and drive (RMS 0.053 -> 0.273).

criteria.label: Declared gaps are accurate
evidence: The decorative declarations are accurate and machine-checkable: the DOM carries 48 data-functional='true' and 99 'false' controls, matching the declared 147/48/99 exactly, and moving the declared-decorative perf.mod-wheel, fx.delay.effects, perf.rotary.source, fx.focus.organ plus six organ/synth controls left the rendered note unchanged to within 0.00-0.02 dB.

Source honesty holds up: the three declared sample sets are genuine recordings with verified headers and byte counts, the three synthesised types are labelled 'SYNTHESISED' in the Program display, and the declared fallback behaviour was reproduced exactly by blocking /samples/** (strip reads 'FALLBACK VOICE', keybed still playable, library never reported ready).

Undeclared missing required features: FX group mode and FX global mode are both required by the effects spec, are both absent from the build, and appear nowhere in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json's list of unsupported controls (which names only fx.delay.effects, fx.focus.organ/synth, perf.rotary.source/stop-mode, the pitch stick, the mod wheel and the Comp FAST indicator). The Amp 'EQ only' type and the Delay filter 'Off' position are likewise missing and undeclared.

One declaration is affirmatively contradicted: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json states 'the reverbs are comb/all-pass tanks whose decay grows Booth < Room < Stage < Hall < Cathedral', but Hall and Cathedral have no decay at all - measured output rises to the 0.894 limiter ceiling and stays there indefinitely after one 200 ms note.

A second claim is inconsistent with the UI: the declared 32-voice cap is real in code (src/audio/pianoEngine.ts:89) but the panel field labelled 'VOICES' displayed 45 and 61 while those notes were held.

issues.title: Hall and Cathedral reverbs self-oscillate to full scale and never decay
issues.detail: In the published build at 48 kHz, a single 200 ms C4 with Reverb type Hall and dry/wet 6.4 produces output RMS 0.047 at 1 s, 0.362 at 4 s, 0.890 at 9 s and 0.894 at 14 s, and never decays; Cathedral reaches 0.894 by 9 s. At dry/wet 10 the tank is already saturated at the 0.8936 limiter ceiling before any note is played, and stays there with no notes sounding. Booth, Room, Spring and Stage decay correctly to 0.000. The comb/all-pass feedback network exceeds unity gain for the two longest decay settings, so two of six reverb types render the instrument unusable until the type is changed or the page reloaded. The candidate's own reverb test only asserts that late energy increases from booth to cathedral (src/audio/effectsUnits.test.ts:352-368), with no upper bound or decay requirement, so unbounded growth passes; those tests also render at 16 kHz through a bundled JS offline renderer (src/audio/offline.ts) rather than a browser audio engine.

issues.title: FX group mode and global mode are absent and undeclared
issues.detail: The effects spec lists 'FX focus following layer focus, manual focus buttons, group mode, and global mode' as required. Focus following and the manual focus buttons work, but there is no group control among the 147 controls in the DOM and no grouping or global field in the settings model (src/audio/settings.ts:71-106). Shift+On, the spec's global gesture, does nothing: with fx.shift On, clicking fx.comp.on left the Compressor reading 'Off' with no display change. Neither omission appears in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json's otherwise thorough list of unsupported controls.

issues.title: Amp/EQ 'EQ only' type and Delay feedback filter 'Off' position missing
issues.detail: The Amp Sim/EQ type button cycles six positions (Twin, JC, Small, To Rotary, LP Filter, HP Filter) against the seven the spec lists, with no 'EQ only' position that would let the EQ be used without an amp colouration. The Delay feedback filter cycles LP/BP/HP against the spec's Off/LP/HP/BP, so the filter cannot be switched out of the feedback path. Both are undeclared.

issues.title: Velocity layers barely change timbre; Dyno tine emulations near-inaudible
issues.detail: Between velocity 0.2 and 0.675 the spectral-band distance is 0.17 dB on Upright and 0.19 dB on Electric, and the RMS ratio is 0.271-0.279 on all six types, so velocity mostly scales gain rather than selecting an audibly different recorded stroke, despite two declared velocity layers for Grand and Upright. On Electric, Dyno 1 differs from Timbre Off by 0.43 dB and from Dyno 2 by 0.83 dB, and Bright moves the centroid only 537 -> 565 Hz against 962 -> 1267 Hz on Grand.

issues.title: 'VOICES' readout shows held keys, not sounding voices
issues.detail: The Program display field labelled VOICES is fed from instrument.heldNotes.size (src/App.tsx:57), so it read 45 and 61 while those keys were held, even though the engine caps polyphony at 32 with voice stealing (src/audio/pianoEngine.ts:89 and :258) and IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares that cap. The engine behaves correctly; the indicator mislabels what it counts.

issues.title: KB Touch offers four settings against the spec's three
issues.detail: The piano spec lists KB Touch as Heavy/Medium/Light; the panel button cycles Medium/Light/Normal/Heavy. All four measurably change the velocity response (0.00442 / 0.02681 / 0.01485 / 0.00890 RMS at one fixed physical velocity), so nothing is broken, but the extra position is not in the spec and is not declared.
